name: Group portrait in front of a temple of Chinese and Western men, China, possibly Peking
summary: José María Sert (1874-1945) was a Spanish artist best known for his mural paintings. Born in Barcelona, Sert began his career in his father’s studio, producing tapestry cartoons and other designs.
